notes: Unlimited-OCR_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Unlimited-OCR: baidu/Unlimited-OCR (MIT; a 3.3B OCR model: the DeepEncoder vision tower, SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L with a projector, and a 12-layer DeepSeek-V2 mixture-of-experts decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request and writes the page as layout blocks (label, box, content). Published 2026-11-15 (Hub main d1907308 at the read of 2026-11-16). Measured on the published bytes (an SSD copy hashed against the Hub digest). Work dir.
quantization: the text decoder (12 layers: the first dense, then 11 mixture-of-experts layers of 64 routed experts, 6 per token, and 2 shared; all 64 routed experts computed as two fully connected ops, the 6 the router picks kept) with dynamic INT8 channelwise weights in its linear layers (the position table stays float) and FP32 activations declared for the GPU; an INT8 embedding table in its own graph; the decoder's and the embedding's weights in external-weights sections of the file; the vision encoder (SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L) and projector with FP16 weights; a 4,096-token context; a KV cache of 405 slots (the 277 prompt positions stay, and a ring holds the last 128 generated positions); signatures prefill_278 and decode; one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request
